name: Darbhanga

queries.query: Darbhanga Bihar official cadastral map land records BhuNaksha district
queries.result: The Darbhanga District Administration links Bihar Bhumi; the state Revenue and Land Records Directorate operates an anonymous BhuNaksha map-sheet viewer; DILRMP has a Darbhanga district cadastral map status report. BhuNaksha client uses WMS map imagery and plot-identification routes; no full parcel vector method/schema was found.

queries.query: दरभंगा भू नक्शा बिहार भूमि अभिलेख आधिकारिक नक्शा
queries.result: जिला प्रशासन का दरभंगा भूमि-अभिलेख पृष्ठ बिहार भूमि पोर्टल से जोड़ता है। बिहार राजस्व एवं भूमि अभिलेख निदेशालय का भू-नक्शा दर्शक जिला, अनुमंडल, अंचल, मौजा और शीट चयन देता है; सरकारी DILRMP डैशबोर्ड में दरभंगा जिला मानचित्र स्थिति है। दर्शक WMS चित्र और प्लॉट-चयन का उपयोग करता है; पूर्ण वेक्टर बहुभुज का सार्वजनिक अनुबंध नहीं मिला।

portals.observation: Official district land-records page links to Bihar Bhumi and is owned by the Darbhanga District Administration (last updated 2026-09-26).
Anonymous official Bihar BhuNaksha shell displays selectors for district, subdivision, circle, mauza, survey type, map instance, and sheet. No feature geometry was requested.
Official viewer client renders map layers as WMS images and calls plot identification after a village/GIS selection. No full-vector polygon route was found in the client.
Official Bihar Directorate of Land Records and Survey lists Bhu-Naksha and Online Map among public services.
Government of India DILRMP district report for Darbhanga publishes cadastral map, village, and parcel digitization status.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official Darbhanga District Administration land-records page links the Bihar Bhumi land-record service. Bihar Revenue and Land Records Directorate provides an official public BhuNaksha cadastral-map viewer with district/subdivision/circle/mauza/map-sheet selectors, and Government of India DILRMP publishes Darbhanga district cadastral-map status. These establish local district land-record/map services, but the city-centroid village and a full-vector endpoint are not verified.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The anonymous official BhuNaksha viewer exposes raster WMS display and plot-identification workflows, not a verified full-vector polygon feed. No feature query or geometry sample was made because the client did not identify a vector route or safe response schema.

registryBasis: The Darbhanga District Administration explicitly locates its Revenue Department in city Darbhanga and links Bihar land records. Its land-record service, Bihar BhuNaksha and DILRMP district cadastral-map report corroborate local land administration. The specific urban mauza and public parcel vector coverage remain unverified.
